skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

version.changelog: 新增功能概览描述，提升搜索匹配度（保留全部规则）

llm.summary: The skill is not malicious, but it needs review because it can analyze face and room photos automatically without a clear opt-in or complete privacy disclosure.

dimensions.detail: The advertised fortune-telling, feng shui, face-reading, BaZi, zodiac, hexagram, and almanac functions are coherent with the skill materials. The face-reading feature intentionally uses sensitive face imagery to infer personality and fortune-style traits, which is purpose-aligned but privacy-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md routes any message containing an image into image mode and auto-classifies pure image uploads into feng shui or face-reading flows. That creates unclear consent boundaries for unrelated image uploads, especially human faces.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instructions, one Python helper, and local YAML knowledge files. Metadata, VirusTotal telemetry, and static scan do not show malicious install behavior or hidden package activity.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The Python script is limited to local calculations for BaZi, zodiac, random hexagrams, and almanac output, with no observed network calls, credential access, destructive commands, or broad filesystem indexing. Image analysis is delegated to the user's agent/Vision Model rather than implemented in code.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts say uploaded photos are only used for the current analysis and not stored or transferred, but big8-plan.md also describes Vision Model processing and claims no third-party upload without defining provider, retention, logging, or user consent details.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a fortune-telling skill analyzing uploaded face or room photos. Avoid sending unrelated images while using it, treat all outputs as entertainment, and do not upload face photos unless you are comfortable with the platform's Vision Model processing them.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] expected: Vision-based face analysis is central to the stated purpose, but the no-third-party privacy claim is under-specified because the artifacts do not explain who operates the Vision Model or what retention/logging applies.
[SDI-1] expected: The executable script only handles non-image helper calculations, while SKILL.md explicitly treats image analysis as Vision Model direct output. This is a product-completeness mismatch more than a security issue.
[SQP-1] expected: Image-triggered routing is expected for feng shui and face-reading, but the rule is too broad because any image causes image mode rather than requiring an explicit analysis request.
[SQP-1] expected: Pure image uploads are automatically classified into room or face analysis, which is purpose-aligned but lacks a confirmation step before sensitive face or private-space interpretation.
[SQP-2] expected: Face-reading and fortune-style inference are clearly advertised, but SKILL.md does not provide a prominent upfront notice that face images are sensitive and optional.
[SQP-2] expected: The plan encourages selfie-based face reading and includes a privacy note, but it does not fully disclose biometric-style sensitivity, provider handling, retention, or consent controls.
